title: Hum Asghari Shah ke Matamdaar Hai
body:
Gham gusaare sayyad e abraar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ashk aankho'n se sadaa barsayenge.
Ghum mein sheh ke qoo'n bahate jaayenge.
Bas azal se apna yeh kirdaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Majlis e shabbir asws. mein aah o buka.
Dard o gham ranj o alam ka tazkira.
Ishq e ahlebait asws. ka izhaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hum hussaini hain kabhi rukte nahi.
Zulm ke aage kabhi jhukte nahi.
Hum mein eemaa'n ka yahi me'aaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Yeh sabeelein aur yeh sheh ki aza.
Hashr tak hoga yeh jaari silsila.
Qush naseeb,, iska haqdaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Paasbaa'n ehle haram ka bawafa.
Neher par baazu kataa kar sogaya.
Fouj e sheh ka jo alambardaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Dekh kar Akbar ko kehte the sabhi.
Hai yeh dilbar sheh ka ya ke hai nabi saww.
Hum shabihe Ahmed e muqtaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai jahan mein aisi yeh sheh ki aza.
Isi se milti hai dua e Fatima s.a.
Aarzoo e Zainab e gham qwaar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hai jo dushman majlis e shabbir ka.
Hai wo dushman deen ki tanveer ka.
Rab ki nazro'n mein wahi ghaddaar hai.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Karbala mein Fatima s.a. ka ghar lutaa.
Dekhiye hai zulm ki yeh inteha.
Bedi pehne aabid e beemar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Hai dua Hyder ki moula se yahi.
Ghum mein sheh ke guzre uski zindagi.
Lab roz o shab suqan har baar hain.
<<MINI>>
Hum asghari sheh ke matamdaar hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam: janab Hyder razvi Hyder sahab.
